newsitem.title: USA: MOTOR RACING-DAVY JONES SUFFERS HEAD INJURIES IN IRL CRASH.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-DAVY JONES SUFFERS HEAD INJURIES IN IRL CRASH.

text.p: American Davy Jones is in critical but stable condition after crashing Thursday in pre-race practice for Saturday's 200-mile Indy Racing League event.
Jones, co-winner of the 1996 LeMans 24 Hours, driving a new G-Force Oldsmobile, got sideways in the third turn and hit the wall suffering head injuries.
He was taken to Orlando Regional Medical Centre for treatment.
